verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an HR and payroll SaaS like Justworks, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only help-center articles on payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and the Xero integration. The 'api/v2/help_center' URLs belong to the help-center hosting platform, not to a Justworks product API, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt on the help domain all returned 404. Nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples.
